# Menu

A dropdown of actions on one thing: the "More" on a card or table row.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Menu` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Menu />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Menu"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Dropdown of actions on one thing, with full keyboard support.

## Props (MenuProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` | Button text and the menu's name. @default "More" |
| `items` | `MenuItem[]` |  |
| `trigger` | `React.ReactNode` | Replaces the button content. |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'end'` | Which edge of the button the menu lines up with. @default "start" |
| `placement` | `'bottom' \| 'top'` | @default "bottom" |
| `onSelect` | `(item: MenuItem, e: React.SyntheticEvent) => void` | Called with the chosen item. |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, 'onSelect'>._
